comment: Deep commercial-cycle schema for a realistic trading company. Applied headlessly by the AgentApi plugin on a fresh database. Money = 'number'. Relationships are Guid FK fields; in the seed a FK is written as '@entity:uniqueValue' and resolved to the referenced record id. Stock is per-warehouse via stock_item (authoritative) plus a denormalized product.stock_quantity total kept in sync by the composed operations. v3 adds master-data (addresses, barcodes, product suppliers, contacts, sales agents), pricing (price lists, exchange rates, discount rules) and warehouse/returns (bin locations, cycle counts, sales returns). v4 adds daily-use document richness: invoice discount/stamp/withholding/reverse-charge/tax-type/customs/posting/storno fields, invoice line types, installments, debit notes, attachments, document audit, bank transactions, reservations and supplier returns.
